Nonconformity description: Quarterly access reviews were required for the finance system but no review was recorded for Q3 or Q4 2025. Sampled 4 quarters, found 2 missing.
Immediate action: Ran the overdue review immediately; removed 3 accounts belonging to leavers.
Root cause: The review existed as a calendar reminder owned by one person with no backstop, so it silently lapsed while they were on extended leave.
Corrective action: Move the review to a ticket raised automatically each quarter, assigned to the role rather than the person, with escalation to the manager if it is still open after 14 days.
Effectiveness result: Effective — Q1 and Q2 2026 reviews both completed within 10 days of the ticket opening.
Evidence reference: Audit report IA-2026-01; tickets ACC-4412, ACC-4703

Nonconformity description: Two of five sampled supplier contracts contained no information security requirements, although both suppliers process customer data.
Immediate action: Notified both suppliers in writing and obtained interim confidentiality undertakings while contracts are amended.
Root cause: Procurement had no trigger to involve security: the contract template contained no security schedule and nothing in the purchasing workflow asked whether the supplier would handle customer data.
Corrective action: Add a security schedule to the standard contract template and a mandatory data-handling question in the purchase request form that routes to the ISMS manager when answered yes.
Evidence reference: External audit report EA-2026-S2; procurement workflow change request PR-118
